description: A high-design corporate boardroom with a refined, contemporary aesthetic. The ceiling is matte black with a suspended arrangement of large cloud or petal-shaped illuminated forms in white that provide dramatic overhead lighting effects — bright diffused white glow emanates downward from these sculptural overhead elements, flooding the table below. The conference table is a long, polished white surface on a dark matte-black base, dressed with open laptops and notepad paper for an active meeting setting. Ten executive task chairs in a two-tone white and tan leather / faux-leather finish surround the table. The back wall is divided into two distinct zones: a warm natural light-oak vertical slatted panel on the left and a deep chocolate-brown accent wall on the right where a large wall-mounted monitor is installed. The left side wall appears to be a polished light grey concrete or plaster finish. The floor is a low-pile commercial carpet in mid-grey. The overall mood is formal, boardroom-authoritative, with a touch of creative studio energy. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered in a wide one-point perspective looking down the length of the conference table toward the back wall. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
